name: freesave-menu-shot
description:
FREESAVE, THE PICTURE. Cold boot, let the intro run, ONE press of A to get from the title screen to the main menu, and stop. Run it against each of the three builds in turn against the SAME .sav; the main menu is where the whole round becomes visible to a player, because it is the screen that either offers CONTINUE or does not, and it is where the play time and badge count are printed.

Exactly one A press, and it is at a screen that cannot commit anything: the title screen's A only opens the menu. A second press would select CONTINUE and start the game — which is how the first version of the read specs accidentally started a NEW GAME and zeroed every probe it was about to read.

This spec asserts almost nothing on purpose. It exists to leave a PNG. The claims live in freesave-read-{control,flipped,swapped}.json.
symbols_from_why: gFreeSaveHookLatch and gFreeSaveOffsets are fork-only symbols.

probes.why: OBSERVATION. Which of the three arms this run is, in one number.
OBSERVATION. Where the single A press left the run.

assert.why: The only assertion here: the boot was cold, so the picture is of a real load rather than of a resumed state.
